_comment: The finale's retreat and defeat (Expansion 6 E.5, game/story/defeat.py): what a retreat from the last fight costs, the tempers of villains who take the beaten alive and the lock on the chest their things go into, and the words.

rival_comes: With a shout, {who} come running onto the field to stand with you!
Horns behind you, and boots: {who} have come after all, blades out.
Out of nowhere {who} are there at your side, just as they swore they would be.
A roar from behind, and {who} hit the enemy's flank like a falling wall.
rival_promised: {who} said they would come. Hold until they do.
Somewhere behind you, {who} are on their way. Buy them the time.
Hold the line: {who} gave their word to be here before the end.
If you can stand a little while, {who} will come.
blessed_bless: You go into it blessed: the light you kindled is still with you.
The beacon's blessing is on you yet, a warmth at the back of the neck.
Something kind goes with you into the dark: the blessing holds.
You feel the prayers of the ones you left behind, steadying your hands.
blessed_courage: You know its true name now. Nothing it can show you will make you run.
Its name is in your mouth, and its terror has no hold on you.
You have said its name aloud, and found it was only a name. You are not afraid.
A name is a small thing to hold, but you hold it, and the fear will not come.
blessed_warded: The wards you raised hold off the cold of the grave.
The marks you painted on your skin still burn faintly: the grave-cold will not bite so deep.
The old wards are on you, and the chill of the dead slides off them.
You carry the wards with you, and the dark cannot get its fingers in.
rite_allowed: You know the words. If it falls, you can finish it for good.
With what binds it in your hands and its name on your tongue, its fall can be its end.
Put it down, and you can say the rest of the rite over it before it rises.
Break it here, and the rite can be finished over what is left.
lieutenant_absent: {who} is not here: the errand worked.
No sign of {who}. The word you put about sent them off, as you hoped.
{who} is somewhere else tonight, chasing a lie you planted. One fewer.
The inside man kept faith: {who} is away on a fool's errand.
journal_retreat: You fell back from the last fight, and the enemy had time to recover.
You ran from the end of it, and lived, and it had time to mend.
Beaten back from the last door, you got away. It is whole again.
You retreated from the final fight. It will be ready for you.
journal_taken: Beaten at the end, you were taken alive and woke in the dark, in chains.
You lost the last fight, and woke in its cells.
Taken alive at the end, stripped of your gear, and thrown in a cell.
Beaten and chained in the dark. It wanted you alive.
retreat: You get clear, and nothing follows. But {villain_short} has the time now to mend, and to make ready, and you have shown {him} your faces.
You fall back, and the dark lets you go. It will not forget, and it will be whole again when you return.
Out, and away, breathing hard. Behind you {villain_short} is already gathering {his} strength again, and what {he} works at will not wait for you.
You have lived to try again. So has {villain_short}, and {he} will use the time better than you would like.
retreat_ally: The one who came with you looks at you a long while when the fighting is done, and then says it plainly: they will not go back down there. You will have to finish it without them.
Your ally has had enough. They are sorry, they say, and they mean it, but they have a life to keep, and they do not think you can win.
When you count yourselves on the road, the one who stood with you is not among you. They went home, someone says. They did not say goodbye.
The one who fought beside you will not meet your eye. They came because they believed you could do it. They do not believe it now.
taken_wake: You wake in the dark, on stone, with iron on your wrists and your head ringing. They did not kill you. {villain_short} wanted you alive, and that is worse.
Cold stone, the smell of old straw and older blood, and chains. You are alive because {villain_short} chose it, and you will not like the reasons.
You come round in a cell somewhere deep in {home}. Your weapons are gone, your armour is gone, and somewhere above you someone is laughing.
Darkness, and the drip of water, and the bite of a fetter. You were beaten, and dragged here, and left to wake. Someone has plans for you.
taken_gear: Your gear was carried off somewhere close: you heard them laugh over it as they went, and a lid slam, and a lock turn.
They took your weapons and armour and your purse, and you heard the lot thrown into a chest not far off.
Everything you fought with is gone, but not far: a locked chest in one of the rooms nearby, if the talk you overheard was true.
Your things are in a strongbox somewhere on this level. You heard the guards arguing over who would have your blade.
escaped: Open sky, and air that does not smell of the grave. You are out of {home}, and alive, and that is enough for now.
You come up out of the dark into the wind, and breathe, and breathe. You got out. Now there is the matter of going back.
Free, and on the road again. {villain_short} will know by morning that the cell is empty.
The world outside is very wide and very bright. You are out of {villain_short}'s hands. It will not be that easy a second time.
